annotations.title: Payout pre-flight: screen a whole recipient list before a batch payment

description: Before payroll, bounty / grant / contributor payouts, airdrops or refunds: up to 200 recipients (optionally with amounts) in ONE call. Per row: format, checksum, network, token-contract / burn addresses, pasted tx hashes or keys, OFAC SDN exact match. Whole list: duplicates (paid twice), look-alike pairs (address poisoning or typos), look-alikes of addresses you trust. Returns the rows to pay, the rows to hold and totals. PAID: $0.050 per call or 50 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/payout-check.

known.description: Optional: up to 50 addresses you already trust (comma-separated); rows that imitate one of them are held.

network.description: Network you will pay on (base, ethereum, arbitrum, tron, solana, bitcoin, ...). Every row is checked against it. Omit to check formats only.

recipients.description: Up to 200 recipients: "address" or "address:amount", separated by commas or new lines (CSV "address,amount" lines and a JSON array of {address, amount} also work). Amounts are plain decimals in any unit.
